z: 我意识到虽然中国发展得很快，中国人还有比较悠闲的生活。
e: I have come to realize that China is developing quickly but the Chinese people live a relatively leisurely life.

z: 不过，除了佛教者以外，没有任何人可以一直遵循这个原则。
e: However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.

z: 中国政府25日发布了《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。
e: On the 25th, the Chinese government issued a white paper entitled "The Diaoyu Islands are China's Inherent Territory".

z: 等到周围只有她一个人的时候，她迫不及待地打开了那封信。
e: The moment she was alone, she opened the letter.

z: 连续下了好几天雨，所以这个足球场有些泥泞，不太好用了。
e: Because it had been raining for a couple of days, the pitch was muddy and difficult to play on.

z: 因为在甲级联赛中，所有队伍都很有实力，净胜球差异很小。
e: Because all of the teams in the Premier League are really strong, the goal difference is usually small.

z: 木头或许能在水里呆上十年，但它终究不可能变成一条鳄鱼。
e: Wood may remain ten years in the water, but it will never become a crocodile.

z: 我不知道他有没有超能力，但是我猜他可能比一般人要强吧。
e: I don't know if he has any special powers or not, but he's probably stronger than a normal human.

z: 据说日本人对他们认识的人非常友好，对不认识的人非常冷淡。
e: It is said that the Japanese are very friendly to those that they know, and very indifferent to those they don't.

z: 要用智慧来理解智慧：如果听众是聋的话，那音乐什么都不是。
e: It requires wisdom to understand wisdom: the music is nothing if the audience is deaf.

z: 即使你的句子实际上是毫无意义的，至少你有幸能造出好句子。
e: Even if your sentences were actually senseless, you at least have the luck to be able to form beautiful sentences.

z: 人们谈到全球气候变化的时候，常常用到“温室效应”这个词。
e: The term 'greenhouse effect' is often used when people talk about global changes of climate nowadays.

z: 这个词指的是由于大气层里二氧化碳含量增多而导致全球变暖。
e: It is a term used to describe the warming of the earth due to increasing amounts of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

z: 旗袍因有与众不同的特点而在国际时尚界享有与日俱增的名望。
e: With its distinctive Chinese features, the qipao enjoys growing popularity in the international world of high fashion.

z: 他们是因为患有一种使他门忽视孩子的基础精神病而过于上网。
e: They used the Internet too much because they had some underlying problem that also caused them to neglect their child.

z: 为享受和生命激活而读书，和为知识和教化而读书，是两码事。
e: There's a big difference between reading for pleasure and stimulation and reading for knowledge and education.

z: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
e: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.

z: 球迷们在为自己喜欢的球队欢呼，看台上总是一片热闹的景象。
e: There was a lot of excitement in the stands as the fans cheered for their teams.

z: “我昨天梦到了你。”“当真？那我（在你梦中）在做什么？”
e: "I dreamed of you yesterday." "Seriously? And what was I doing?"

z: 昨天哥哥去福岛给当地居民帮忙了。我对放射量的增加很害怕。
e: Yesterday my big brother went to Fukushima to help the locals. I'm very afraid of the rise in radiation levels.

z: 你很容易把母语说得通顺流畅，却很容易把非母语说得不自然。
e: It's very easy to sound natural in your own native language, and very easy to sound unnatural in your non-native language.

z: 自行车当然会磨损，但只要你保养得好，就能骑很长一段时间。
e: Bicycles wear out, of course, but with proper care they may be made to last a long time.

z: 我们必须学会像兄弟一样共同生活，要么就像傻子一样同归于尽。
e: We must learn to live together as brothers, or we will perish together as fools.

z: 专家说只有百分之十五左右的快乐来自收入、资产等财政的因素。
e: Experts say only about 15 percent of happiness comes from income, assets and other financial factors.

z: 请把发给你的那张单子看一下，再确认一下所有的句子都很通顺。
e: Read the list we sent you and check that all the sentences sound natural to you.

z: 翻译就像一个女人。她漂亮就会不忠诚；她忠诚就肯定不会漂亮。
e: Translation is like a woman. If it is beautiful, it is not faithful. If it is faithful, it is most certainly not beautiful.

z: 我每隔一天就跟一个好朋友一起去，我们一起一边谈话一边举重。
e: Every other day I go with a friend; we lift weights whilst chatting together.

z: 快要考试的时候，举重真的消愁解闷，再说对身体和精神都很好。
e: When you're about to have exams, lifting weights really does relieve stress, and it's also good for your mind and body.

z: 在中国，历史以三十年为极限，我们不可能知道三十年以前的事。
e: In China, the history began thirty years ago; we can't know what happened any farther back than thirty years.

z: 我承认，没有他，我未来十年的生活将会是空虚的、没有目标的。
e: I admit that if it weren't for him, the next ten years of my life would have been empty and devoid of purpose.

z: 这大概是我最后一次环球旅行，在此之后，我就不再环游世界了。
e: This is probably my very last world trip. After this one, I'm done.

z: 在这种困难的时候，任何寻常的努力都无法使我们的公司摆脱赤字。
e: In hard times like this, no ordinary effort can get our company out of the red.

z: 战争不是轻易就应该开始的，所以也不能够因为像打仗就改变宪法。
e: War isn't something to be done lightly, also changing the constitution isn't something that should be done because "I just really want to go to war".

z: 美国有两大政党，一是较为保守的共和党，一是较为自由的民主党。
e: There are two major political parties in the United States: the conservative Republican Party, and the liberal Democratic Party.

z: 那多山地区还没有高速路。所有货运被驮在人的背上或在马的背上。
e: There still aren't any highways in this mountain region. All goods are transported on the backs of people and horses.

z: 能向别人自顾自地单向倾诉、想说什么就说什么，这比什么都难得。
e: To have someone you can vent to nonstop, saying absolutely anything on your mind, this is rarer than anything else.
